filter_sets.narrow: Hedges 各类“窄/特异”版（治疗、诊断、病因、预后、临床预测）+ 系统综述 + 指南/共识 + 兽医观察性研究发布类型
filter_sets.narrow_core: 同 narrow，但去掉病因、预后两类（这两类在大专题里噪声最大；具体病种子专题仍用较宽的过滤）
filter_sets.narrow_core+prevalence: narrow_core + 患病率/发病率/寿命题名词（Hedges 没有患病率过滤；本站保留患病率问题，按 Iorio 2015 和 JBI 患病率清单处理）
filter_sets.hybrid: 治疗、预后用 Hedges“宽/敏感”版，诊断、病因、临床预测用“窄”版 + 系统综述 + 指南/共识 + 兽医试验/观察性研究发布类型
filter_sets.broad: Hedges 全部“宽/敏感”版 + 系统综述 + 指南/共识 + 兽医试验/观察性研究发布类型（仅用于每周量很小的专题）

therapy_narrow.query: ("Randomized Controlled Trial"[pt] OR (randomized[tiab] AND controlled[tiab] AND trial[tiab]))

diagnosis_narrow.source: PubMed Clinical Queries Diagnosis/Narrow；Haynes RB, Wilczynski NL. BMJ 2004;328:1040（PMID 15073027）

etiology_narrow.query: ((relative[tiab] AND risk*[tiab]) OR "relative risk"[tw] OR risks[tw] OR "Cohort Studies"[MeSH:noexp] OR (cohort[tiab] AND study[tiab]) OR (cohort[tiab] AND studies[tiab]))
etiology_narrow.source: PubMed Clinical Queries Etiology/Narrow；Wilczynski NL, Haynes RB. AMIA 2003:719-23（PMID 14728267）

sr.source: PubMed Systematic Review 过滤 systematic[sb]（PubMed 帮助页）+ Montori VM 等 BMJ 2005;330:68（PMID 15619601）的 meta-analysis[pt]/"systematic review" 词；补 meta-analy*[ti]（库内 39858209 未被 systematic[sb] 收录）

guideline.query: ("Practice Guideline"[pt] OR "Guideline"[pt] OR "Consensus"[pt] OR "Consensus Development Conference"[pt] OR guideline*[ti] OR consensus[ti] OR recommendation*[ti] OR "task force"[ti] OR "position statement"[ti])
